span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE SAME TECHNICAL PROBLEM IS REPORTED TO HAVE DIFFERENT SEVERITY IN TWO FIELDS, AND THE CONTRAST IS DRAWN EXPLICITLY: EVEN WHEN DATA IS ANNOTATED BY DOMAIN EXPERT, LABEL NOISE CAN BE A SIGNIFICANT LIMITING FACTOR - **WHEREAS IN COMPUTER VISION THE NOISE IN THE LABELING OF IMAGES IS TYPICALLY RELATIVELY LOW**. The word `label` names something with a different reliability depending on who produced it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A REFERENCE STANDARD IS BUILT WITH CONSENSUS DELIBERATELY NOT FORCED, AND THE DISAGREEMENT THEN OUTNUMBERS THE AGREEMENT THREE TO ONE: nodules were annotated by four radiologists INDEPENDENTLY, the readers REVIEWED EACH OTHERS ANNOTATIONS **BUT NO CONSENSUS WAS FORCED** - and the number they DID NOT UNANIMOUSLY AGREE ON to be a nodule **WAS THREE TIMES LARGER THAN THE NUMBER THEY DID FULLY AGREE ON**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE CONSEQUENCE FOR ANYTHING TRAINED ON IT IS STATED, AND THE FIX IS AN OPEN PROBLEM: training a system on such data REQUIRES CAREFUL CONSIDERATION OF HOW TO DEAL WITH NOISE AND UNCERTAINTY IN THE REFERENCE STANDARD - one COULD THINK OF solutions like incorporating labeling uncertainty directly in the loss function, **BUT THIS IS STILL AN OPEN CHALLENGE**. The uncertainty is acknowledged and has nowhere to go
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A BINARY PRESENTATION OF THE TASK IS CALLED A GROSS SIMPLIFICATION, AND THE REASON IS HETEROGENEITY ON BOTH SIDES: classification is often presented as A BINARY TASK - normal versus abnormal, object versus background - **HOWEVER THIS IS OFTEN A GROSS SIMPLIFICATION AS BOTH CLASSES CAN BE HIGHLY HETEROGENEOUS**. Not one class hiding structure but both
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE `NORMAL` CATEGORY IS SHOWN TO CONTAIN THINGS THAT ARE NOT NORMAL, INCLUDING ARTIFACTS OF THE INSTRUMENT: the normal category OFTEN CONSISTS OF COMPLETELY NORMAL TISSUE **BUT ALSO** several categories of BENIGN FINDINGS, WHICH CAN BE RARE, and MAY OCCASIONALLY INCLUDE **A WIDE VARIETY OF IMAGING ARTIFACTS**. The residual class is defined by what it is not, and collects the measurement's own failures
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE PERFORMANCE PATTERN IS PREDICTED FROM THE CATEGORY'S STRUCTURE: systems end up GOOD AT EXCLUDING THE MOST COMMON NORMAL SUBCLASSES **BUT FAIL MISERABLY ON SEVERAL RARE ONES**. A single accuracy figure over a heterogeneous class hides exactly the failures that matter, and the shape of the class predicts the shape of the failure
span.note: about this quote: RE-SLICED off a damage combination I had not seen before today and which NONE of my guards catch: the sentence reads "systems that are **ex- 25 tremely** good at excluding" - a line-break hyphen RETAINED (shape 11) with a PAGE NUMBER inserted at the break. The page-number guard needs a lowercase letter before the digit and finds "- "; the hyphen guards look for a fused or a surviving hyphen, not one with a number wedged into it. So the sentence's most important word is destroyed and every check passes. The span now starts after it.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE CORRECT FIX IS NAMED AND DECLINED ON COST, IN ONE SENTENCE: a STRAIGHTFORWARD SOLUTION would be to turn the system into a MULTI-CLASS one by providing DETAILED ANNOTATIONS OF ALL POSSIBLE SUBCLASSES - **OBVIOUSLY THIS AGAIN COMPOUNDS THE ISSUE OF LIMITED AVAILABILITY OF EXPERT TIME FOR ANNOTATING AND IS THEREFORE OFTEN SIMPLY NOT FEASIBLE**. The right answer is known and unaffordable
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE WORKAROUNDS ARE REPORTED TO FAIL FOR THE SAME REASON THE PROBLEM EXISTS: strategies that incorporate intelligence in the training process - selective sampling, hard negative mining - **TYPICALLY FAIL WHEN THERE IS SUBSTANTIAL NOISE IN THE REFERENCE STANDARD** - and ADDITIONAL METHODS FOR DEALING WITH WITHIN-CLASS HETEROGENEITY WOULD BE HIGHLY WELCOME. The noise in the labels defeats the corrections for the labels
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A STAIN IS OFFERED AS A SUBSTITUTE FOR EXPERTISE: in histopathology one can sometimes use SPECIFIC IMMUNOHISTOCHEMICAL STAINS to highlight regions of interest, **REDUCING THE NEED FOR EXPERT EXPERIENCE** - and non-expert labels can be leveraged VIA CROWD-SOURCING. Two ways to replace a judgement: a reagent and a crowd
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A BENCHMARK IS REPORTED TO HAVE SATURATED, SO THAT IMPROVEMENTS CAN NO LONGER BE ATTRIBUTED: since 2014 the performance on the benchmark HAS SATURATED and **IT IS DIFFICULT TO ASSESS WHETHER THE SMALL INCREASES IN PERFORMANCE CAN REALLY BE ATTRIBUTED TO 'BETTER' AND MORE SOPHISTICATED ARCHITECTURES**. The scare quotes on `better` are the paper's, and the measuring instrument has stopped discriminating
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A PERFORMANCE CRITERION IS DECLARED INSUFFICIENT AND SUPPLEMENTED BY AN ARTICULATION CRITERION, JUSTIFIED BY LEGAL ACCOUNTABILITY: these methods have often been described as BLACK BOXES, and especially in medicine WHERE ACCOUNTABILITY IS IMPORTANT AND CAN HAVE SERIOUS LEGAL CONSEQUENCES, **IT IS OFTEN NOT ENOUGH TO HAVE A GOOD PREDICTION SYSTEM** - the system ALSO HAS TO BE ABLE TO **ARTICULATE ITSELF** in a certain way. What counts as success acquires a second component from outside the field
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A SURVEY DE-DUPLICATES ITS OWN POPULATION BY A JUDGEMENT IT NEVER DEFINES, AND SUPPLIES A WORKED EXAMPLE INSTEAD OF A CRITERION: when largely overlapping work had been reported in multiple publications, **ONLY THE PUBLICATION DEEMED MOST IMPORTANT WAS INCLUDED** - **A TYPICAL EXAMPLE HERE WAS ARXIV PREPRINTS THAT WERE SUBSEQUENTLY PUBLISHED**, or conference contributions later expanded into journal papers. What `most important` means is stated nowhere, the survey's whole 308-paper population rests on it, and the example is doing the work a definition would have done
span.note: about this quote: The span carries this file's surviving line-break hyphens - “publica- tions”, “contri- butions” - quoted verbatim, because a quote is the staged file's bytes. AND THE SPAN IS IN TEXT THAT WAS NOT STAGED UNTIL 2026-08-17: this record held 64% of its source and stopped mid-clause, so these sentences were never available to any earlier pass. See Q-713.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: open challenges and future-research directions remain in the field

Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The survey deliberately excludes traditional (non-deep) feature-learning approaches applied to medical images.
span.note: what this limits: any comparison between deep and traditional methods drawn from this survey: WE FOCUS PARTICULARLY ON SUCH DEEP MODELS, AND DO NOT INCLUDE THE MORE TRADITIONAL FEATURE LEARNING APPROACHES THAT HAVE BEEN APPLIED TO MEDICAL IMAGES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Coverage has a hard cut-off date, so later work is not included.
span.note: what this limits: every count and trend in the survey: THE LAST UPDATE TO THE INCLUDED PAPERS WAS ON FEBRUARY 1, 2017
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Completeness of the literature search is an expectation rather than a guarantee.
span.note: what this limits: the completeness of the literature search behind those counts: WE EXPECT THE SEARCH TERMS USED TO COVER MOST, IF NOT ALL, OF THE WORK INCORPORATING DEEP LEARNING METHODS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: On a widely used dataset the disputed annotations outnumber the agreed ones three to one.
span.note: what this limits: any accuracy reported on the LIDC-IDRI dataset: no consensus was forced between the four radiologists, and the number of nodules they did not unanimously agree on was three times larger than the number they did fully agree on
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Label noise is worse in this field than in the field the methods came from, and the survey says so.
span.note: what this limits: any transfer of a computer-vision result to medical imaging: label noise can be a significant limiting factor even with domain-expert annotation, whereas in computer vision the labelling noise is typically relatively low
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Training on such data is stated to be an open problem, not a solved preprocessing step.
span.note: what this limits: any system trained on a disputed reference standard: the authors state that handling noise and uncertainty in the reference standard requires careful consideration and that incorporating labelling uncertainty in the loss function is still an open challenge
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: deep convolutional networks, developed in computer vision, adopted as the methodology of choice for medical image analysis (classification, detection, segmentation)

span.label: the reference standard - AN ANNOTATION SET WITH ITS DISAGREEMENT LEFT IN: four radiologists annotated independently, reviewed each other, and NO CONSENSUS WAS FORCED, so what every accuracy on this dataset is measured against is a set whose disputed part is three times its agreed part - the standard is not a ground truth but a record of expert disagreement
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: label noise - A FIELD-RELATIVE QUANTITY: the survey contrasts medical imaging, where it can be a significant limiting factor even with domain-expert annotation, against computer vision, where it is typically relatively low - so the same word names a small nuisance in one literature and a limiting factor in the other, and the architectures move between them
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the binary task - A STATED SIMPLIFICATION: normal versus abnormal is called a gross simplification because both classes are highly heterogeneous, which is why systems can excel on common normal subclasses and fail on rare ones; the two-class label is a choice about the data, not a property of it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
